question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

For many, a warming climatic system is expected to impact the availability of basic necessities like freshwater, food security, and energy, while efforts to redress climate change, both through adaptation and **__mitigation__**, will similarly inform and shape the global development agenda.
solution: The correct answer is "reduction."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "mitigation" means the action of reducing the severity, seriousness, or painfulness of something. (किसी चीज़ की गंभीरता या पीड़ा को कम करने की क्रिया) • Example: *There has been no significant increase in funding for flood **mitigation**__ works.* • The synonym of "Mitigation" is "Reduction." • The word "Reduction" means the action of becoming or making something less or smaller. (पहले से कम या छोटा होने या करने की क्रिया; कमी, घटाव, कटौती) __ • Example: ***Reduction**__ of the fracture corrects and maintains alignment.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Rise: **an increase in an amount, a number or a level. (वृद्धि (मात्रा, संख्‍या या स्‍तर में)) • **Cure: **a medicine or treatment that can cure an illness, etc. (रोग का उपचार करने वाली औषधि या चिकित्‍सा) • **Balance: **a situation in which different or opposite things are of equal importance, size, etc. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें विभिन्न प्रकार की या विपरीत वस्तुओं का आकार, महत्व आदि समान होता है; संतुलन, संतुलन की स्थिति) 3b:Tcac, The correct answer is** ****"****The children were plucking the flowers in the garden."**
